MediaRemote.h and MediaRemote.m are unmodified from
https://github.com/ungive/mediaremote-adapter at
0e82bf1c44ec39554fbfc402ec88a48c6ae2a0fd (src/private/).

Licence checked in the author's repository: BSD-3-Clause, retained in LICENSE
and copied beside the framework in the Mac application. The Perl host loading
technique follows that project; FluidEQ's notification, lifecycle, command and
capability handling is its own. No upstream debounce or timed stream is used.
